453.title: ArtofTomworks · LTX 2.5 Simple [GLOBAL]
453.body:
Proven Gym image-to-video pipeline · 1088 × 1920 · 7 s · 24 FPS.
Two sampling passes, latent spatial upscale, audio and live monitoring.
Replace the sample image and prompt before running. This label is not burned into the video.

454.title: QUICK START · OUTPUT
454.body:
1. Replace the sample first frame and scene prompt.
2. Check duration, FPS and output size.
3. Leave LoRA off unless it is compatible with LTX 2.5.
4. Run and find the video in the SaveVideo node.

The saved Gym generation settings are unchanged.

455.title: LIVE STATUS · CPU / GPU / VRAM
455.body:
The LTX monitor shows elapsed/final time, stage ETA and system load.
After a successful run, it remembers the duration for the next full-run estimate.
Both estimates are approximate; the previous run must use comparable settings.

457.title: LANGUAGE SELECTION
457.body: Choose EN, HU, DE, FR, ES, IT, PT or PL. The labels and LTX monitor switch together. Video generation settings do not change.

458.title: REQUIREMENTS AND HELP
458.body:
Required: LTX 2.5 FP8 model, Gemma text encoder, LTX 2.5 video/audio VAEs, LTX latent 2× upscaler. Extensions: rgthree Power LoRA, KJNodes preview, Crystools, ArtofTomworks monitor. Pro retains the existing graph's optional interpolation element, disabled by default.

ComfyUI: https://docs.comfy.org/installation/install_custom_node
rgthree: https://github.com/rgthree/rgthree-comfy
KJNodes: https://github.com/kijai/ComfyUI-KJNodes
Crystools: https://github.com/crystian/ComfyUI-Crystools

453.title: ArtofTomworks · LTX 2.5 Simple [GLOBAL]

1088 × 1920 · 7 s · 24 FPS

454.title: SCHNELLSTART · AUSGABE
454.body:
1. Startbild austauschen und Prompt eingeben.
2. Dauer, FPS und Größe einstellen.
3. Optional eine kompatible LTX-LoRA aktivieren.
4. Starten; Ergebnis in SaveVideo und output/video.

Latente Hochskalierung verbessert räumliche Details, nicht die FPS.

455.title: LIVE-STATUS · CPU / GPU / VRAM
455.body: Der Monitor zeigt Laufzeit, geschätzte Restzeit der Sampling-Phase sowie CPU-, GPU-, VRAM- und RAM-Auslastung. Hardwarewerte kommen von Crystools; Dekodierung und Speichern sind nicht in der ETA.

457.body: Sprache wählen: HU, EN, DE, FR, ES, IT, PT oder PL. Beschriftungen und Monitor wechseln gemeinsam; Generierung bleibt gleich.
